title: Vector-valued C¹ approximation of Lipschitz maps ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q (componentwise Simon Ch. 2, 1.5)
statement: Let n, Q ∈ ℕ, let u : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q be Lipschitz with constant K ≥ 0 (ℝᵐ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), and let ε ∈ (0, ∞]. Then there exist a closed set A ⊆ ℝⁿ with Lⁿ(ℝⁿ ∖ A) < ε (Lⁿ = volume) and a C¹ map G : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q such that for every x ∈ A: u(x) = G(x), and u has Fréchet derivative DG(x) at x.
lean_statement: ∀ (n Q : ℕ) (u : Eucl n → Eucl Q) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K u → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ (A : Set (Eucl n)) (G : Eucl n → Eucl Q), IsClosed A ∧ (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) Aᶜ < ε ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 G ∧ ∀ x ∈ A, u x = G x ∧ HasFDerivAt u (fderiv ℝ G x) x
